{"format":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"verdict":{"enum":["A","B"],"type":"string"}},"required":["verdict"],"type":"object"},"messages":[{"content":"Read the passage below and classify how it is written.

A. CONNECTED PROSE -- complete sentences that follow from one another, where the
   relationships between the points are spelled out in words.
B. A LIST -- separate items stated one after another, with no wording that
   relates them to each other, whether or not the items are full sentences.

PASSAGE
-------
The deadline is 1 March 2026. Length requires at least 22 pages, with exactly 22 satisfying the minimum. Format demands an official template or three years documented revision history, though Track D submissions exempt this specific requirement in exchange for exactly two endorsements; one endorsement proves insufficient. Prior round acceptances block handling if fewer than five years elapsed, whereas exactly five years permits processing. Venue presentations at Tier-1 venues are rejected unless exceeding 18 months prior to the deadline, meaning precisely 18 months disqualifies the submission. Paired submissions allow exactly two manuscripts where both meet length and format rules independently, requiring only one manuscript to clear the venue restriction.

Figure counts must remain between 8 and 45 inclusive for single submissions; paired submissions extend the maximum to 70 figures while retaining the minimum of 8. Figures falling below the minimum trigger a PADDED verdict rather than return, provided no other rule fails. However, exceeding any applicable figure maximum results in an immediate RETURNED verdict regardless of padding logic. Crucially, an open retraction notice prevents handling entirely, overriding all other provisions including those regarding figures or venue overlap. Withdrawals reset the venue clock to the withdrawal date for prior round calculations but do not constitute acceptances under prior round rules. Ensure that Track D exemptions apply solely to format requirements and do not negate retraction prohibitions or figure limits.

Answer with exactly one letter: either "A" or "B".","role":"user"}],"model":"llama3.3:70b","options":{"seed":3184000083,"temperature":0.7},"stream":false}
